notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[p]I took the summer off from Condo and just enjoyed watching people explore this little world from a distance. Still, a few things kept bugging me, so here’s what’s new in 1.0.3:[/p][list][*][p][b]Controller Support:[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
[p]It was absolutely thrilling to read your response to [i]Condo[/i] during its first days of release! ♥ Thanks to you all, I was able to further fine-tune the game, which is insanely appreciated. Anyway, here’s what’s new in [i]1.0.2[/i].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Wider resolution support:[/b] 
The game is designed for a 4:3 aspect ratio and will automatically switch to 1440x1080. However, players using different resolutions - or systems that don't support the default - will now see the UI adapt accordingly. If there's still any issues here, let me know![/p][p][/p][p][b]Minor world tweaks:[/b]
Just small things here and there. I decided [i]not[/i] to fix the out-of-bounds glitch because, honestly, it looks super fun.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Future updates: [/b]ヘ(* 。* ヘ)
I’m not ready to move on from [i]Condo[/i] yet. There are some ideas that I would still like to implement. Not sure when though; I’m figuring out how to test the Linux build first. Will keep you posted!
[/p][p]xoxo[/p]

tags.feature:
Wider resolution support:
The game is designed for a 4:3 aspect ratio and will automatically switch to 1440x1080. However, players using different resolutions - or systems that don't support the default - will now see the UI adapt accordingly. If there's still any issues here, let me know!
